title: How oil price shocks redraw the map of conflict
title_zh: 油价冲击如何重塑冲突版图
authors: Maximilian Herrmann, Jingke Pan, Axel Dreher
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Oil price shocks do not simply make conflict more likely everywhere; they change where violence happens. Using monthly georeferenced data for 131 low- and middle-income countries from 1989 to 2021, this column shows that higher oil prices pull organised conflict towards petroleum fields, while protests and attacks rise around refineries and pipelines. Aggregate conflict statistics can therefore look calm while the local map of violence is being redrawn.
abstract_zh: 油价冲击并非简单地使冲突在全球范围内更易发生，而是改变了暴力事件的发生地点。本文利用1989年至2021年间131个低收入和中等收入国家的月度地理参考数据表明，油价上涨会将有组织冲突引向油田区域，同时炼油厂和管道周边的抗议与袭击事件也会增加。因此，当局部暴力地图正在被重新绘制时，总体冲突统计数据可能看似平静。

title: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
title_zh: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来
abstract: Globalisation has changed economic research profoundly, making it more comparable, more competitive, and thoroughly quantitative. This column argues that AI may unsettle this new order as thoroughly as globalisation unsettled the old one and discusses the technical and geopolitical mechanisms at work. One prediction can be made with high confidence: someone who wakes up thirty years from now is likely to recognise economics as little as someone who fell asleep thirty years ago and just woke up today.

title: Scars of War: The Legacy of WWI Deaths on Civic Capital and Combat Motivation
title_zh: 战争伤痕：一战死亡对公民资本与战斗动机的遗留影响
authors: Carozzi, Felipe, Pinchbeck, Edward, Repetto, Luca
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study how the legacy of WWI deaths affected British communities and the next generation of soldiers. Our instrumental-variable estimates show that servicemen from localities that suffered heavier losses in WWI were considerably more likely to die or win gallantry medals in WW2. To contextualise these findings, we show that the mortality shock increased communities’ inter-war civic capital as demonstrated by the creation of war memorials, veterans’ associations and charities, and increases in pro-social participation. Our results highlight the importance of past conflicts in fostering pro-social behaviours which, in turn, can shape the motivation of soldiers in future wars.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一战死亡遗留问题如何影响英国社区及下一代士兵。工具变量估计表明，来自一战损失更惨重地区的军人在二战中阵亡或获得英勇勋章的可能性显著更高。为阐释这些发现，我们证明死亡率冲击通过战争纪念碑、退伍军人协会和慈善机构的建立，以及亲社会参与度的提升，增强了社区在两次世界大战间的公民资本。研究结果凸显了过往冲突在培育亲社会行为中的重要性，而这种行为反过来可能塑造未来战争中士兵的动机。

title: Daughters like mothers? New evidence of inter-generational transmission of labor market stereotypical behavior
title_zh: 女儿像母亲？劳动力市场刻板行为代际传递的新证据
abstract: Recent literature provides evidence of inter-generational correlation regarding gender-stereotypical behavior in the labor market. There are two potential explanations for this pattern: selection and causality. Relying on identification through second moments, we reveal a striking result among female adolescents in Germany and Australia. The apparent positive correlation between mothers and daughters is entirely driven by selection, suggesting that sticky gender norms are responsible for persistent gender segregation in the labor market. Most surprisingly, we find that causality operates in the opposite direction, suggesting that the mother holding a non-stereotypical job may have an ambiguous effect on the daughter’s occupational choice. Our findings have important implications for policymakers and identify new directions for future research. We highlight the need to investigate the mechanisms of transmission further to design policies that are successful at closing the remaining gaps. Our findings also suggest that policies designed to foster balanced gender compositions may fall short of achieving the desired inter-generational spillovers unless fundamental shifts in underlying gender norms occur.
abstract_zh: 近期文献提供了劳动力市场中性别刻板行为代际相关性的证据。这一现象存在两种可能的解释：选择效应与因果效应。通过利用二阶矩识别方法，我们在德国和澳大利亚的女性青少年中揭示了一个惊人结果：母女之间看似正向的相关性完全由选择效应驱动，这表明僵化的性别规范是导致劳动力市场持续性别隔离的根源。最令人意外的是，我们发现因果效应呈现反向作用——母亲从事非刻板职业可能对女儿的择业产生模糊影响。本研究对政策制定具有重要启示，并为未来研究指明了新方向。我们强调需进一步探究传导机制，以设计能有效弥合现存性别差距的政策。研究同时表明，除非根本性转变潜在性别规范，否则旨在促进性别平衡构成的政策可能难以实现预期的代际溢出效应。

title: Credit Expansion in the Caucasus and Central Asia
title_zh: 高加索和中亚地区的信贷扩张
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes credit developments in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) using several complementary approaches. First, it estimates long-run equilibrium credit levels based on economic fundamentals, providing benchmarks to assess whether observed credit levels are broadly aligned with country characteristics. Second, it applies statistical “gap” measures to identify periods of unusually rapid credit expansion that may signal emerging financial vulnerabilities. Third, it uses the Kalman filter to decompose credit into trend and cyclical elements conditional on macro variables. The results suggest there is scope for further financial deepening in all CCA economies, but the speed of household credit expansion warrants close monitoring. A comparative “horse race” of alternative indicators suggests that no single measure consistently outperforms others across countries, implying that combining various credit gap measures enhances the robustness of risk assessments.
abstract_zh: 本文采用多种互补方法分析高加索和中亚地区的信贷发展。首先，基于经济基本面估算长期均衡信贷水平，为评估实际信贷水平是否与各国特征基本一致提供基准。其次，运用统计"缺口"指标识别可能预示金融脆弱性出现的异常快速信贷扩张期。第三，利用卡尔曼滤波法将信贷分解为趋势成分与周期成分，并使其以宏观变量为条件。研究结果表明，所有高加索和中亚经济体均存在进一步深化金融的空间，但家庭信贷扩张速度需密切监测。通过比较不同指标的"赛马"分析发现，没有任何单一指标能在各国间持续优于其他指标，这意味着综合运用多种信贷缺口指标可增强风险评估的稳健性。

title: Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
title_zh: 空气污染与儿童早期发展结果：来自佐治亚州儿童保育机构的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于污染对学龄前儿童教育的影响仍知之甚少。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。结果显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每增加一个单位，出勤率下降约2个百分点。该效应在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。

title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging: How G7 Finance Ministries Communicate
title_zh: 解码财政信息：七国集团财政部如何沟通
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fiscal policy has re-emerged as a central tool of macroeconomic stabilization, yet the way governments communicate fiscal choices remains poorly understood. This paper provides the first systematic analysis of fiscal communication across the G7 from 2000–2024. Using a new dataset of budget documents, ministerial speeches, and press communiqués, we examine the clarity, thematic content, and rhetorical tone of official fiscal statements through computational text-analysis methods. We uncover a structured but fragmented communication architecture. Technical documents emphasize sustainability and constraints; speeches underscore growth, fairness, and investment; and press releases distill policy packages into succinct signals. Despite rising expectations of transparency, fiscal language remains complex and often optimistically framed. These patterns reflect institutional design, political incentives, and macroeconomic conditions. Our findings highlight fiscal communication as an underappreciated dimension of economic governance, one that shapes expectations, conditions credibility, and warrants deeper integration into fiscal policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 财政政策已重新成为宏观经济稳定的核心工具，然而政府沟通财政选择的方式仍鲜为人知。本文首次对2000-2024年间七国集团的财政沟通进行了系统性分析。通过运用预算文件、部长演讲和新闻公报的新数据集，我们采用计算文本分析方法，考察了官方财政声明的清晰度、主题内容和修辞语气。研究发现了一种结构化但碎片化的沟通架构：技术文件强调可持续性与约束条件；演讲侧重增长、公平与投资；新闻公报则将政策方案提炼为简洁信号。尽管透明度预期不断提升，财政语言仍保持复杂且常带有乐观倾向。这些模式反映了制度设计、政治激励和宏观经济状况的影响。我们的研究凸显了财政沟通作为经济治理中未被充分重视的维度——它塑造预期、影响可信度，并值得更深入地融入财政政策分析。

title: The Value of One Office Day a Month
title_zh: 每月一天办公室办公的价值
authors: Cevat Giray Aksoy, Nicholas Bloom, Steven J. Davis, Victoria Marino, Cem Ozguzel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Remote work has expanded rapidly, but the value of regular in-person contact remains unclear. We report a randomized controlled trial in which a large multinational randomly assigned 248 customer-service employees to remain fully remote or to work at the office together one day a month. Monthly office days gradually increased productivity, with treated employees handling 7.8% more calls per hour in the post-intervention period. Office days also strengthened workplace communication: treated employees spent 36 additional minutes communicating with colleagues in the week after an office visit, were more likely to report receiving manager feedback, and employee pairs randomly assigned as desk neighbors were 11 percentage points more likely to communicate afterward. In addition, monthly office days reduced attrition by a third. The resulting gains in productivity and retention generated a benefit–cost ratio of about 5:1. These findings show that limited, coordinated in-person contact can improve communication, performance, and retention in remote teams.
abstract_zh: 远程工作迅速普及，但定期面对面接触的价值仍不明确。我们报告了一项随机对照试验，一家大型跨国企业将248名客服员工随机分配为完全远程办公或每月有一天共同到办公室工作。每月办公室工作日逐渐提高了生产率，在干预后阶段，受处理员工每小时处理的电话数量增加了7.8%。办公室工作日还加强了职场沟通：受处理员工在办公室访问后一周内与同事的沟通时间增加了36分钟，更有可能报告收到管理者的反馈，且被随机分配为相邻工位的员工在之后沟通的可能性提高了11个百分点。此外，每月办公室工作日将员工流失率降低了三分之一。由此带来的生产率和留任率提升产生了约5:1的收益成本比。这些发现表明，有限且协调的面对面接触能够改善远程团队的沟通、绩效和留任率。

title: Financial Well-being and Inclusion of Justice Involved Populations: Evidence from the SHED
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
authors: Kabir Dasgupta, Jennifer Fernandez, Alicia Lloro
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines financial challenges faced by justice-involved individuals using 2023-2024 Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking data. Individuals with justice system contact experience substantially worse financial outcomes than those without criminal records, with disparities widening by severity of involvement. Compared to individuals with no prior records, those arrested but not convicted are 4 percentage points less likely to report doing at least okay financially, while formerly convicted as well as incarcerated adults are 15 percentage points less likely. Formerly incarcerated individuals are also 21 percentage points less likely to have credit scores above 660 and 13 percentage points less likely to have credit cards. These disparities mirror patterns observed across education levels, where adults with lower educational attainment experience lower financial well-being and inclusion. Our findings document substantial barriers to financial stability among justice-involved populations and may inform policies promoting financial inclusion and improving economic outcomes for this group.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2023-2024年美国家庭经济与决策调查数据，考察了涉法个体面临的金融挑战。与无犯罪记录者相比，有司法系统接触经历的个体在财务结果上显著更差，且差距随涉法程度加深而扩大。相较于无前科者，曾被逮捕但未被定罪者报告财务状况至少尚可的概率低4个百分点，而曾被定罪及监禁的成年人则低15个百分点。曾被监禁者信用评分超过660分的概率低21个百分点，持有信用卡的概率低13个百分点。这些差异与不同教育水平群体中观察到的模式一致——受教育程度较低的成年人财务福祉与金融包容性更低。研究结果揭示了涉法群体在金融稳定性方面面临的重大障碍，可为促进该群体金融包容性、改善其经济状况的政策制定提供参考。

abstract: 본 연구는 새로운 지식(혁신)의 창출 현황을 ‘국가-산업 간 네트워크’ 관점에서 살펴보고 ‘혁신 네트워크’ 참여의 경제적 함의에 대해 분석하였다. 지금까지 정책 입안자들은 기술을 발전시키고 혁신 역량을 강화하면서 의례히 자국의 R&D 투자 총액을 늘리는 데 집중해 왔다. 하지만 현대 사회에서 혁신은 한 국가, 산업 또는 기업의 자체적인 R&D만으로는 달성이 불가능하다. 한 국가 내에서뿐만 아니라 국경을 넘어 다른 나라에서의, 다른 산업에서의 혁신은 또 다른 국가로, 또 다른 산업으로 여러 경로를 통해 공유되고 전파되므로 이 점을 충분히 고려하여 정책을 만들어 나가야 한다. 특히 한국의 경우 네트워크의 중요성은 다시 한번 강조될 필요가 있다. This research project examines the current state of new knowledge creation from the perspective of global knowledge networks and analyzes the economic implications of participating in the so-called ‘innovation network.’ Policymakers have as a matter of course prioritized increasing their own country’s total R&D investment to advance technology and strengthen innovation. This research, however, asserts that in our current economic environment innovation cannot be achieved solely through the R&D of a single country, industry, or company. Policies must be formulated with the full understanding that innovation is shared and disseminated across borders—flowing from other countries and industries to new ones through various channels. For Korea, in particular, participating in these networks are critical.
abstract_zh: 本研究从“国家-产业间网络”视角审视新知识（创新）的创造现状，并分析了参与“创新网络”的经济含义。迄今为止，政策制定者在推动技术发展、强化创新能力时，通常侧重于增加本国研发投资总额。然而，在现代社会中，创新无法仅凭单一国家、产业或企业自身的研发实现。创新不仅在一国内部，更跨越国界，从其他国家、其他产业通过多种渠道共享与传播至另一国家或产业，因此政策制定必须充分考虑这一点。尤其对韩国而言，网络的重要性需要再次强调。

title: The economic consequences of cultural diversity in political organizations
title_zh: 政治组织中文化多样性的经济后果
abstract: I study the economic consequences of cultural diversity within political organizations. Using manually collected data on 25,568 members of county-level standing committees of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database from 1998 to 2013, I find that cultural diversity in county standing committees significantly reduces industrial output. I further identify potential mechanisms: greater committee diversity is associated with lower government and capital construction spending, slower and weaker responses to public appeals, and lower labor and capital inputs as well as enterprise investment. Moreover, counties with more culturally diverse standing committees exhibit lower nighttime light intensity and reduced per capita GDP. Overall, these results highlight a potential limitation of China’s current political organizational structure and institutional arrangements.
abstract_zh: 我研究了政治组织内部文化多样性的经济后果。基于手动收集的1998年至2013年间中国共产党县级常务委员会25568名成员数据及中国工业企业数据库，发现县级常委会的文化多样性显著降低了工业产出。进一步识别出潜在机制：委员会多样性程度越高，政府与基建支出越低，对公众诉求的响应速度与力度越弱，劳动与资本投入及企业投资也相应减少。此外，文化多样性更高的县级常委会所在地区，夜间灯光强度与人均GDP均有所下降。总体而言，这些结果揭示了中国现行政治组织结构与制度安排可能存在的局限性。
